faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCDC Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 19th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional (Media Communication) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or a 2-year Post Graduate Diploma in Media Management, Mass Communications, Journalism, or Mass Multimedia & Communications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the NCDC Young Professional position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Young Professional role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and a Personal Discussion.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional (Media Communication) is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Young Professional (Media Communication).

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The salary is negotiable and will be based on the last/current pay drawn by the candidate.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information.
